imgeo-2.2.note: Patterns (regular expressions) on retrieved URLs. source = 1 when at least one retrieved URL is authoritative and none is non-authoritative.

subsurface.note: The local model bundle and MCP server are not URL retrievals. MCP source attribution is not implemented yet.

dsfl.note: The registrations the dsfl questions need: the BAG and the BRO groundwater monitoring wells. bag.ldproxy.net republishes the BAG 2.0 Extract with history, which the PDOK WFS lacks; the working group still has to confirm that it counts as authoritative. publiek.broservices.nl is the public service of the BRO and broloket.nl its public viewer.
